title: 5-Day Raffles Grand Angkor Golf & Ancient Temple Classic
description: Heritage French colonial elegance at Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor. Play Sir Nick Faldo’s Angkor Golf Resort, Phokeethra, and Siem Reap Booyoung.

signatureTour.title: The Khmer Temple Trail
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our premier 7-day signature tour featuring private temple scholars, monk water blessings, and exclusive banquet dining.

inclusions.detail: Chauffeured executive vehicles for all airport, temple, and golf course connections.
3 rounds: Angkor Golf Resort (Sir Nick Faldo), Phokeethra Country Club, and Siem Reap Booyoung.
4 nights in a Landmark Room at Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor (est. 1932).
Private guided sunrise temple exploration with an expert archaeological scholar.
Signature welcome Singapore Sling / Airavata cocktail at the historic Elephant Bar.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Siem Reap & Heritage Colonial Suite Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Colonial Heritage Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Siem Reap–Angkor International Airport (SAI) where your private chauffeur welcomes your group and transfers you to the storied Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor. Operating continuously since 1932, the property features historic timber elevators, French colonial archways, and the largest historic pool in Cambodia.

Unpack in your Landmark Room before meeting in the legendary Elephant Bar for a welcome Airavata cocktail, followed by refined Royal Khmer cuisine at 1932 restaurant.

itinerary.title: Sir Nick Faldo’s Masterpiece: Angkor Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Faldo Championship Design
itinerary.imageCaption: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Angkor Golf Resort, Sir Nick Faldo's award-winning championship design. Manicured Paspalum fairways wind around natural water hazards, challenging your approach shots into bold, undulating green complexes.

Conclude your round with drinks in the modern clubhouse before returning to Raffles for a relaxing afternoon swim in the heritage pool.

itinerary.title: Dawn Angkor Wat Scholar Tour & Phokeethra Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Heritage & Tournament Golf
itinerary.imageCaption: Phokeethra Country Club — Weerayudth Phetbuasak (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Phokeethra Country Club championship golf course Weerayudth Phetbuasak Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Experience a magical private sunrise tour of Angkor Wat led by an expert archaeological scholar, exploring quiet inner sanctuaries ahead of the public. After a gourmet temple breakfast, head to Phokeethra Country Club, managed by Sofitel, featuring a scenic 11th-century stone bridge and natural lakes.

Return to Raffles for an evening of relaxation in the spa and an exquisite dinner in the gardens.

itinerary.title: Kentaro Sato Design at Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Strategic Japanese Parkland
itinerary.imageCaption: Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club — Kentaro Sato (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club championship golf course Kentaro Sato Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play the immaculate parkland layout at Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club, designed by renowned Japanese architect Kentaro Sato. Sculpted fairways, picturesque lake carries, and fast greens deliver a satisfying test.

Celebrate the final round with farewell drinks at the Elephant Bar, reflecting on an extraordinary week of Khmer culture and golf.

itinerary.title: Morning Garden Stroll & Airport Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast on the terrace before checking out with the assistance of your AGS concierge.

Your private executive transfer transports your party to Siem Reap–Angkor International Airport for your departure flight.

faqs.question: What is the dress code for visiting Angkor temples?
faqs.answer: Visitors must cover shoulders and knees when entering temple sanctuaries; lightweight linen shirts and trousers are ideal.
